Maya (People Ops): Quick update: we've published a minor handbook update for the parental leave reimbursement process. The change clarifies eligible expenses and the new receipts upload flow. Please review and ack by EOW.
Theo (Benefits): New co-pay schedule and reimbursement portal link here: https://handbook.redwood.com/benefits/parental-reimbursement. Receipts must be uploaded as PDF or PNG.
Priya (Recruiting): Heads-up for hiring managers: we now include a one-time reimbursement note in offer packets for eligible roles. Recruiting template updated.
Oliver (Eng): Does this change affect contractors who transition to FT within 90 days?
Maya (People Ops Manager): Good catch. Contractors who convert to FT within 90 days are eligible pro-rata from their FT start date. We'll add a clarifying paragraph.
onboard-bot: Reminder: ack required in handbook page to trigger reimbursement eligibility checks.
Theo (Benefits): Process note: finance needs receipts within 60 days of expense or the claim will be returned. Use the portal reference ID when emailing finance.
Priya (Recruiting): For offers this week, should I push the updated template or wait until the paragraph is added?
Maya (People Ops): Push the template now and add a parenthetical note that final eligibility is subject to policy; we'll update the handbook paragraph tomorrow morning.
Oliver (Eng): Thanks. Also can we confirm whether lactation equipment purchases are covered? Looking at the doc but want assurance.
Theo (Benefits): Lactation pump purchases are covered with prior approval. Add the receipt + physician note if requesting reimbursement over the base amount.
Maya (People Ops Manager): We'll host a 20-min FAQ drop-in Wed 11:00 PT. Invite will be posted in #people-ops. If you're in EMEA/APAC, reply here and we'll offer an alternate time.
Priya (Recruiting): Adding note to offer checklist. Thanks team.
Maya (People Ops): Final: ack required by 2026-06-04. We'll include training completion in the monthly compliance snapshot for managers.
